metadata.description: Validated longevity compounds with clinical evidence, SMILES, and quantum simulation parameters
metadata.evidence_standard: Minimum: registered clinical trial OR peer-reviewed in IF>10 journal with >50 citations

compounds.name: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
compounds.mechanism: Substrate for NAMPT → directly converted to NAD+ in salvage pathway

clinical_evidence.key_result: 250mg/day increased blood NAD+ by 38% in 12 weeks (Yoshino et al., Science 2021)

key_papers.title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide increases muscle insulin sensitivity in prediabetic women
NAD+ repletion improves mitochondrial and stem cell function

safety.known_risks: Generally well-tolerated. No serious adverse events in trials up to 1250 mg/day.

compounds.name: NR (Nicotinamide Riboside)
compounds.mechanism: Phosphorylated by NRK1/2 to NMN, then to NAD+. Alternative entry into salvage pathway.

clinical_evidence.key_result: 1000mg/day NR elevated NAD+ by 60% and reduced systolic BP by 9 mmHg (Martens et al., Nat Comm 2018)

key_papers.title: Chronic nicotinamide riboside supplementation is well-tolerated and elevates NAD+ in healthy middle-aged and older adults
NR augments the human skeletal muscle NAD+ metabolome

safety.known_risks: Mild GI symptoms at high doses. Well-tolerated in 12-week trials.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Kinase phosphoryl transfer mechanism involves charge delocalization

compounds.name: Fisetin
compounds.mechanism: Multi-target senolytic: inhibits BCL-xL (pro-survival), PI3K/AKT, and induces apoptosis selectively in senescent cells. Does NOT kill healthy cells.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Reduced senescence markers (p16, p21, SASP) in frail elderly (Yousefzadeh et al., EBioMedicine 2018 - preclinical)

key_papers.title: Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan
Fisetin reduces frailty markers in humans

dosing.bioavailability: Low oral (~10%), enhanced with lipid formulation

safety.known_risks: Short pulse dosing minimizes off-target effects. Flavonoid — GRAS status.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: π-stacking in BH3 groove — dispersion correlation needs CCSD-level treatment

compounds.name: Dasatinib + Quercetin (D+Q)
compounds.mechanism: Synergistic combination: Dasatinib targets senescent preadipocytes (via Src/Abl), Quercetin targets senescent endothelial cells (via BCL-2/PI3K). Together eliminate broader range of senescent cell types.

clinical_evidence.key_result: First human senolytic trial: 3-day course reduced p16+ cells, improved physical function in IPF patients (Hickson et al., EBioMedicine 2019)

key_papers.title: Senolytics decrease senescent cells in humans: preliminary report
Senolytics improve physical function and increase lifespan in old age

dosing.bioavailability: D: 14-34% oral; Q: low, enhanced by piperine

safety.known_risks: Dasatinib: neutropenia risk with chronic use (solved by intermittent dosing). Quercetin: GRAS.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Kinase hinge region H-bond network + halogen bonding in Dasatinib requires correlation

compounds.name: Rapamycin (Sirolimus) — low-dose intermittent
compounds.mechanism: Rapamycin binds FKBP12 → complex inhibits mTORC1 → activates autophagy, reduces SASP, mimics caloric restriction without actual fasting.

clinical_evidence.key_result: 6 weeks low-dose (5mg/week) enhanced immune response to flu vaccine by 20% in elderly (Mannick et al., Sci Transl Med 2018)

key_papers.title: TORC1 inhibition enhances immune function and reduces infections in the elderly
Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice

safety.known_risks: Chronic high-dose: immunosuppression, hyperlipidemia. LOW-DOSE INTERMITTENT avoids these (Mannick data). Monthly CBC recommended.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Macrolide ring conformational strain + intramolecular H-bond network — correlation effects missed by DFT

compounds.name: Metformin
compounds.mechanism: Inhibits mitochondrial Complex I → increases AMP:ATP ratio → activates AMPK → inhibits mTOR, activates autophagy, reduces inflammation. Pleiotropic longevity effects.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Observational: diabetics on metformin live LONGER than non-diabetic controls (Bannister et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2014). TAME is the first FDA-approved aging trial.

key_papers.title: Metformin as a tool to target aging
Can people with type 2 diabetes live longer than those without?

safety.known_risks: GI upset (5-10%), lactic acidosis (extremely rare). 60+ years of safety data in billions of patients.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Complex I contains Fe-S clusters — strong correlation in d-electrons, DFT fails

compounds.name: Spermidine
compounds.mechanism: Inhibits EP300 acetyltransferase → deacetylation of autophagy proteins (ATG5, ATG7, LC3) → robust autophagy induction → cellular cleanup of damaged organelles.

clinical_evidence.key_result: High dietary spermidine intake associated with 5.7-year reduced mortality risk (Kiechl et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2018). SmartAge trial showed improved memory in elderly.

key_papers.title: Cardioprotection and lifespan extension by the natural polyamine spermidine
Higher spermidine intake is linked to lower mortality

dosing.human_dose: 1-5 mg/day (supplement) or high-spermidine diet (wheat germ, natto)

safety.known_risks: Endogenous molecule. No adverse events reported in trials. Found in all human cells.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Polyamine-protein charge transfer interactions in EP300 active site

compounds.name: Cycloastragenol (TA-65)
compounds.mechanism: Activates telomerase via upregulation of hTERT gene expression. Does NOT directly bind hTERT catalytic site — acts as transcriptional activator through NF-κB/AP-1 pathway.

clinical_evidence.key_result: 12 months TA-65: shortened telomeres became longer, CMV-specific T-cells increased (Harley et al., Rejuvenation Res 2011)

key_papers.title: A natural product telomerase activator as part of a health maintenance program
A natural product telomerase activator lengthens telomeres in humans

dosing.bioavailability: Low oral, triterpenoid — lipid formulation helps

safety.known_risks: Cancer safety gate: 1-year study showed NO increase in cancer incidence. Telomerase activation is transient, not constitutive. p53/Rb checkpoints remain intact.
safety.cancer_mitigation: Intermittent dosing (3 months on / 1 month off). Monitor PSA, mammogram baseline. Contraindicated in active cancer.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: hTERT two-metal-ion Mg²⁺ mechanism — static correlation in metal-oxygen bonds

compounds.name: Navitoclax (ABT-263)
compounds.mechanism: BH3 mimetic — directly binds anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family proteins in their BH3 groove, releasing pro-apoptotic BAX/BAK to trigger mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and apoptosis in senescent cells.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Single dose cleared senescent cells and rejuvenated hematopoietic stem cells in aged mice (Chang et al., Nature Medicine 2016)

key_papers.title: Clearance of senescent cells by ABT263 rejuvenates aged hematopoietic stem cells
Senolytic therapies for healthy longevity

dosing.human_dose: 150-325 mg (oncology dose — senolytic dose TBD, likely lower)

safety.known_risks: Thrombocytopenia (BCL-xL in platelets). Senolytic use requires short pulse dosing to minimize platelet toxicity. Platelet-sparing BCL-2-selective analogs (venetoclax) being explored.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Deep BH3 groove binding — extensive π-stacking + halogen-σ hole interactions need correlation

compounds.name: α-Ketoglutarate (AKG)
compounds.mechanism: Cofactor for TET DNA demethylases and Jumonji histone demethylases. Supplementation restores youthful DNA methylation patterns (epigenetic reprogramming). Also inhibits ATP synthase → mild mTOR suppression.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Calcium-AKG reduced biological age by 8 years (DNA methylation clock) in 7-month trial (Demidenko et al., Aging 2021)

key_papers.title: Rejuvant®, a potential life-extending compound formulation with alpha-ketoglutarate and vitamins
α-Ketoglutarate extends lifespan in C. elegans

dosing.bioavailability: Moderate oral (Krebs cycle intermediate — readily metabolized)

safety.known_risks: Endogenous metabolite (Krebs cycle). No serious adverse events. Calcium salt form avoids acidity.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: TET active site contains Fe(II) center — d-electron correlation in iron-oxo intermediate

compounds.name: Urolithin A
compounds.mechanism: Gut microbiome-derived metabolite of ellagitannins. Directly activates mitophagy via PINK1/Parkin — clears damaged mitochondria. Increases mitochondrial membrane potential, muscle endurance, NAD+ levels.

clinical_evidence.key_result: 500mg/day for 4 months improved muscle strength by 12% in elderly. First mitophagy compound with Phase 3 data.

key_papers.title: Urolithin A induces mitophagy and prolongs lifespan in C. elegans and increases muscle function in rodents
Urolithin A supplementation for muscle health in older adults

safety.known_risks: Well-tolerated. GRAS status. No SAEs in 4-month Phase 3.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: PINK1 kinase activation involves conformational allosteric change — limited quantum advantage, classical sufficient

compounds.name: Taurine
compounds.mechanism: Essential for mitochondrial tRNA taurine modification. Without taurine modification, mitochondrial translation stalls → Complex I dysfunction → accelerated aging. Also antioxidant and anti-inflammatory.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Massive cross-species study (Science 2023): taurine decline DRIVES aging. Supplementation extended healthspan 10-12% in mice.

key_papers.title: Taurine deficiency as a driver of aging
Taurine and aging: implications for tissue homeostasis

safety.known_risks: Endogenous amino sulfonic acid. Used in energy drinks for decades. GRAS. No adverse events at standard dosing.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: No significant quantum advantage — classical methods adequate for taurine interactions

compounds.name: Sulforaphane (Nrf2 activator)
compounds.mechanism: Modifies cysteine residues on KEAP1 (Cys151, Cys273, Cys288) → releases Nrf2 from degradation → activates 200+ cytoprotective genes (NQO1, HMOX1, GCLC, GPX). Master antioxidant AND anti-inflammatory switch.

clinical_evidence.key_result: Broccoli sprout extract reduced NF-κB inflammatory markers by 20-30% in elderly (Houghton et al., Mol Nutr Food Res 2016).

key_papers.title: Pharmacological targeting of the Nrf2-KEAP1 pathway
Sulforaphane and aging: from bench to bedside

dosing.human_dose: 10-60 mg/day (standardized sulforaphane from broccoli seed extract)

safety.known_risks: GRAS. Mild GI. May interact with CYP1A2 substrates. High doses may affect iodine uptake.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: Isothiocyanate-thiol covalent modification involves charge transfer TS — moderate multi-reference character

compounds.name: Glycine (GlyNAC)
compounds.mechanism: Three-fold: (1) Substrate for glutathione synthesis (rate-limiting in aging); (2) Methyl group homeostasis via GNMT for DNA methylation fidelity; (3) Anti-inflammatory via glycine-gated chloride channels on macrophages.

clinical_evidence.key_result: GlyNAC supplementation reversed 8 of 9 aging hallmarks in elderly humans within 16 weeks (Kumar et al., J Gerontol 2023).

key_papers.title: Supplementing glycine and N-acetylcysteine (GlyNAC) in older adults improves glutathione deficiency, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammation, and multiple aging hallmarks
Glycine and aging: evidence for a role of glycine in longevity

safety.known_risks: Endogenous amino acid. No adverse events at 15g/day in trials.

quantum_sim_params.quantum_advantage_reason: No quantum advantage — glycine interactions are classical
